Pursuant to the order dated 25.10.2024, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the sale
deed now stands executed in favour of the respondent-Estate Estate Officer, Hsvp, Faridabad and
the amount of compensation stands paid in favour of petitioners vide different drafts (total 07);
photocopies of the same are taken on record and the details thereof are given as under:
In view of above, the present petition is disposed of.

3. Learned counsel for the respondents submits that the petitioners would be at liberty to challenge the assessment of compensation paid to them 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:147283 under the sale deed by way of filing reference petition under Section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Bill, 2013 of the within four weeks from to today, day, which shall be dealt with by the Appropriate Authority-cum-Land Authority Land Acquisition Collector, within four weeks thereafter.
